title: icarium native waivers
description: Suppression entries keyed by rule plus driver/receiver globs. First matching waiver wins, in file order. Additive evolution within major version 1.

id.description: Stable waiver identifier, unique within the file.

rules.description: Rule IDs this waiver excuses; "*" matches every rule.

dst.description: Glob over the receiver cell/port name, or over the slash-joined instance path when prefixed with "inst:". Null matches any receiver.

driver.description: Glob over the driver name or "inst:"-prefixed instance path. Null matches any driver; findings without a driver never match a driver pattern.

reason.description: Human justification, recorded on every finding this waiver excuses.

expires.description: Strict YYYY-MM-DD expiry. Expired waivers warn and never match.
